scope: Private same-executable Windows NT10 x64 report role and owned durable metadata. Public evidence.export parameters, common service/watch and frontend parity remain pending; no production journal/storage ABI.
definition: Freeze the joint case/source/effect definition together with current worker image hash, source/input revision, target profile, host applicability and execution-directory final/ancestor generations. Worker and report producer image hashes must agree. Bind report.request, report.records, report.cancel and report.admission metadata effects separately. Preparation requires an existing empty ordinary local directory and creates nothing. Refuse case-store sharing and reserved output-name aliases.
grant: Before path reconstruction require exact wrapper definition_digest and explicit case_read, report_write, store_write, host_effects. Store writes include immutable request/claim, bounded append-only history and one-byte cancel request. These are declarations, not authenticated approvals. Fresh native case/artifact/producer/output reconstruction must still match; no recorded image/copy/map path is followed.
admission: Create a restricted current-user claim without overwriting; preserve the created fact before validation. Allocate report-op, attempt and worker epoch identities and bind actual metadata file identities. Flush canonical immutable header and initial prepared state. Self-spawn through an explicit inherited capability list with no standard handles or shell. Match current executable, host and job limits before execution. Wait at most 3000 ms for admission; unknown retains the actual operation ID. No timeout kill, restart, removal or replacement attempt. Partial stores prevent another start. A repeated matching start observes the existing operation.
state: Prepared has not_started effects; executing has in_flight effects; finished carries exact joint output/source outcome and receipt with observed or uncertain effects. Cancellation request persistence and worker-observed cancellation are separate. All records bind operation/attempt/worker/image/host and actual process ID/creation identity; a sequence is local to that attempt. Release source/output handles before recording quiescent finished state. Quiescence is no further provider work, not process exit. Compatible inspect may read old code evidence without admitting that binary to write again.
history: Closed bounded canonical UTF-8 JSON LF hash chain, first sequence 1/prepared, at most 16 records and 1 MiB, 64 KiB per row. Validate u64 bounds, exact identities, monotonic phase/cancellation, no post-terminal records, reviewed artifact counters/receipt and outcome relationships. Wall FILETIME is an observation, not a monotonic clock. A torn final suffix retains prior validated state but makes observation unknown; invalid complete rows refuse. Hashes authenticate no actor. Failed terminal persistence cannot promote an independently present output to completed operation evidence.
cancellation: Persist requested cancellation only for a validated active state and the exact cancel-file identity. Worker checks bounded one-byte 0/1 flag at exporter checkpoints and records its first observation. Retain any created/partial output. A completed effect can precede a late cancellation request; preserve its actual completion and distinguish not observed request from refusal or rollback. Finished cancellation is too_late. No result or journal file is automatically erased.
containment: Use existing same-user/session aggregate four-process/512 MiB job and one-process/128 MiB private job; no kill-on-job-close. Client departure does not own worker lifetime. A finite admission wait does not bound blocked Windows file calls or prove quiescence. Inspect validates chain/file/host/store and observes exact PID/creation/path where available; absence/unavailability/reused identity are distinct. Common frontend waiting/watch admission remains separate.
qualification: Run real same-executable ordinary child processes against generated acquisition metadata and explicit disposable outputs. Independently verify output bytes and history hashes/identities. Separate fault executable injects admission/effect/receipt delays, after-create checkpoint pause and metadata write/full/short failures. These are API/process observations, not physical-storage, power-loss, malicious same-user isolation or multi-platform qualification.
next_gate: Close public export prepare/execute parameter/result/descriptor contracts, bounded common-service dispatch/reconnect/inspect/watch/cancel and real CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell journeys before evidence.export availability. Authenticated custody, current image verification, physical devices, other platforms and owner/release acceptance remain separate.
